Morbstack guest Docker engine binaries provenance
===================================================

Source: https://download.docker.com/linux/static/stable/aarch64/
Archive: docker-29.7.1.tgz  (latest available in that directory at time of
         fetch; directory listing showed versions from docker-17.x era up
         through 29.7.1 for the "stable" aarch64 channel)
Archive sha256: 4eb4d1b21131897ed3990aac31039161bf4bdd07fcfb733e996010319ff4e069
Archive size:   77317619 bytes
Docker version: 29.7.1

NOTE on checksum verification: download.docker.com's static binary
directory does NOT publish a companion .sha256/.sha256sum/.asc file next
to the tgz (checked docker-29.7.1.tgz.sha256, .sha256sum, .asc — all
404). The sha256 above is what this download actually hashed to, recorded
for future reproducibility/tamper-detection, but it is NOT independently
verified against a Docker-published checksum (unlike GitHub-release
artifacts which usually ship a checksums file). If stronger verification
is needed later, cross-check against Docker's install script
(get.docker.com) or docker/docker-install repo which sometimes pins
hashes, or verify the extracted `docker` binary's `docker version`
output/build metadata against the official release notes.

docker-rootless-extras-29.7.1.tgz exists in the same directory but was
intentionally SKIPPED per task instructions (not needed — rootless mode
is irrelevant to Morbstack's single-VM-guest dockerd-as-root design).

Extracted binaries (from docker/ inside the tgz) -> dist/guest-bin/:

  file                        sha256                                                            arch/type
  ----                        ------                                                            ---------
  containerd                  9afba5d84c3de5cba841aab3645efec2f131ddb0b167682727c2af560d59dc33  ELF aarch64, statically linked (Go), stripped
  containerd-shim-runc-v2     5068a6b0f28fb306204184109b0235c6c49f898cfc9f5fd5a1453935ceb9d6b7  ELF aarch64, statically linked (Go), stripped
  ctr                         010d17a83c3b4777d249d748837afbf5f0c8a51a176d69051feb00ee775ae5a7  ELF aarch64, statically linked (Go), stripped
  docker                      5cb021bfd638cdba5c96bfcc539b26c3d916387c76b0849fb0bed4e6c76d4ec0  ELF aarch64, statically linked (Go), with debug_info, not stripped
  docker-init                 ab2244312e069c6c97bece2437f61fb01db474eae5b0f1ce006162e212eae5b0  ELF aarch64, statically linked, stripped (tini)
  docker-proxy                a8c30594c9cd02db6d934987cff295d30474a1a63ac65b43342acb572c27e5cc  ELF aarch64, statically linked (Go), not stripped
  dockerd                     c21f09a3e626b478d7aba9e0c0852e5468c87bc3616ca3774f4595d173a883bc  ELF aarch64, statically linked, not stripped
  runc                        3e7ba3d1f270ec4253d689e39da6732a70b441eeae9910aedb07d6e566d8624a  ELF aarch64, static-pie linked, with debug_info, not stripped

All 8 binaries verified via `file` to be ARM aarch64 and statically
linked (no dynamic ELF interpreter), so they should run in a minimal
guest rootfs (e.g. the Alpine minirootfs in dist/rootfs/) without needing
matching libc/shared libraries.

Download command used:
  curl -L -o docker-29.7.1.tgz \
    https://download.docker.com/linux/static/stable/aarch64/docker-29.7.1.tgz
  tar xzf docker-29.7.1.tgz   # produces docker/{docker,dockerd,containerd,...}

Userland proxy
==============

The guest's userland proxy path is /usr/local/bin/morbstack-docker-proxy,
a symlink to /init (morbinit) created by scripts/mkinitramfs.sh — not a
fetched artifact, so it has no entry here. It leases each published port
on the Mac over vsock 2382 and then execs the stock docker-proxy above
with the original argv. dockerd itself is the unmodified upstream static
binary listed in this file; Morbstack no longer builds or ships a patched
engine (the downstream Moby patch was removed together with its
build-engine workflow and fetch path).
